title: Bar Salts Peach Pineapple Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape Bar Salts Peach Pineapple Watermelon is a bright and juicy tropical medley combining the rich sweetness of Peach, the zesty tang of Pineapple, and the light, refreshing notes of Watermelon. This well-balanced flavour delivers a layered and exotic vaping experience, perfect for fans of fruit given a tropical twist. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG blend, Vampire Vape Bar Salts provide the perfect balance of flavour and vapour production, making them ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as vape starter kits , refillable vapes and pod kits . The nic salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and fast-acting nicotine relief, replicating the intense, concentrated flavours and fast-acting satisfaction of disposable vapes. As a sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vape bars, Bar Salts e-liquids come in a 10ml format, providing vapers with a longer-lasting and more sustainable vaping solution. Available in 0mg, 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Peach Pineapple Watermelon is a versatile and flavour-packed choice for adult smokers and vapers.
